text.en: Shoots erratic bullets from all gun barrels at the same time.
Shoots erratic bullets from all gun barrels at the same time.

Fires 3 evenly spread pellets around the center pellet in an alternating triangle pattern for each shot. The central pellet always stays within the accuracy cone around your reticle.

Pellets experience 'reverse range falloff' at close-mid range and deal less damage the closer you are to the target: Deal 16.67% decreased damage at point-blank, scaling up to base damage at 14 meters (22.4 when ADS).

Beyond ~30 meters (~53 when ADS), damage starts experiencing regular falloff.
